themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents that autonomously perform research tasks, manage workflows, and generate insights for researchers.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and understand code, accelerating software development.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered platforms and tools designed to assist researchers in various aspects of their work, from data analysis to literature review.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Includes articles discussing AI's capability to condense large amounts of text, audio, or video into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers AI's use in analyzing user feedback, reviews, and social media to understand emotions and opinions.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Features AI applications that assist in the process of testing the usability and effectiveness of products and interfaces.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is being integrated into the design process for user interfaces, user experiences, and creative assets.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines the effects of AI on jobs, skills, and the overall labor market, including fears of displacement and the need for upskilling.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial users or data for testing, training, or simulating real-world user behavior.

themes.name: AI product research
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in understanding product performance, market trends, and user engagement for product development and strategy.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
